name: Just a RANDOM Game
detailed_description:
"Welcome to the buggiest alpha test you never signed up for."

—Dev, probably

‎ ‎‎ ‎

‎ ‎‎ ‎

On a random day in a random year, you suddenly become... low-res. The sky’s clearly fake, the janky textures are loading in real time, and your body feels like it’s been animated by someone who’s never seen a spine. Then a voice pops up, calling itself “Dev.” Apparently, you’ve been trapped inside a game he “RANDOMLY decided to make one day.”

Good news: you’re not dead.
Bad news: you have to debug the entire game world.

Thrown into a broken game with minimal instructions, you'll survive by chopping wood, mining stones, and crafting whatever tools you can—just to stay alive. Your only real help? Bot, your chatty sidekick who’s occasionally useful. As for Dev? Don’t count on him. He made this mess.

Dev says that if you finish the game, you’ll be able to go home. No promises though. So navigate the chaos, fight off bugs, and try not to lose your mind. It’s broken, it’s glitchy, yet you’ve got no choice but to see it through.

Game Highlights

  • Try to make sense of the chaos and Escape the game!

  • Unlock new chunks, collect resources, and battle mobs

  • Farm, fish, mine ores, chop trees, or just relax

  • Stuck? Don’t worry, Dev will help you (probably)

  • Team up with your hyperactive but totally reliable robot sidekick, Bot!

  • Defeat reified bugs and report them to Dev—who... won’t fix them

  • Short, but jam-packed with fun

  • Expect the unexpected—this game’s full of surprises!

short_description: Trapped in a strange, unfinished game, you must explore random chunks, gather resources, and fend off dangerous mobs. Watch out for bugs lurking in the shadows—while a mysterious developer named Dev claims to help. But can you trust him? Try to escape back to the real world... if you can, of course!
